Container.Name: arrscope
Container.Overview: Filter your Radarr and Sonarr media library using existing filenames and API metadata. Local SQLite cache. No media mounts, no scans. One local admin login. Configure API connections in the WebUI.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: WebUI port on the dedicated container IP.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Local SSD/pool path. No SMB/NFS. Owner must match UID/GID in Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: HTTPS proxy
Config.Description: Set true only when the browser accesses this app through HTTPS.

Config.Name: Go memory target
Config.Description: Soft Go memory target, clamped to three eighths of the container memory limit to retain headroom.

Config.Name: Go CPU parallelism
Config.Description: Limit Go execution threads to two by default.
